About.title: About Us
About.lead: Vairutya is an artisanal studio for mindful living, where ancestral wisdom meets contemporary restraint.
About.tagline: Designed in France. Blooming in India.
About.philosophy1: Modern life is loud. Well-being has become an industry of excess — endless protocols, synthetic noise, and fleeting trends that pull us further from our own intuition.
About.philosophy2: This studio was conceived as a quiet counterweight. Born in 2023 as an intimate Health Management Club and refined over years of rigorous design discipline in France, the house emerged from a singular conviction: true luxury is biological ease. It is the clarity of a body in rhythm, the stillness of an unhurried ritual, and the permanence of objects made with intention.
About.philosophy3: Today, realized as a full-scale living studio in India, we translate timeless natural science into modern daily practice — stripped of dogma, elevated in form, and built for the way we live now.
About.ethosIntro: Existing at the intersection of ancient Indian wisdom and French editorial minimalism, we do not build rules to complicate life, nor formulations to create dependence. Every object, botanical blend, and ritual is guided by three quiet principles:
About.principle1Text: Stripping away the non-essential until only what genuinely serves the body and senses remains.
About.principle2Text: Designing tools, recipes and rituals that return individuals to their own natural rhythm and intuition.
About.principle3Text: Honoring pure materials, unhurried processes, and thoughtful form made to endure.

Careers.title: Careers
Careers.text: We're not actively hiring right now, but we're always happy to hear from people passionate about wellness, Ayurveda, and science-backed nutrition. Reach out via our <link>contact page</link> and we'll keep your details on file.

Science.title: Our Science
Science.p1: Every recommendation on Vairutya is grounded in two complementary frameworks: modern nutritional and biological research, and centuries-old Ayurvedic understanding of the body's doshas.
Science.p2: Our quizzes translate Ayurvedic concepts like Vata, Pitta, and Kapha into practical insights about digestion, stress response, hormonal rhythm, and circadian alignment — all supported by current research on gut health, cortisol regulation, and sleep science.
Science.p3: We work with certified Ayurvedic practitioners and continuously review our product formulations and workshop content against both traditional texts and peer-reviewed research.

Refund.title: Refund & Cancellation Policy
Refund.cancel: If you wish to cancel your order, write to us at sales@vairutya.com within 24 hours of placing the order.
Refund.refund: Refunds are only processed for fulfilment errors, such as incorrectly shipped or missing items. The amount is refunded to the original mode of payment within 7 business days of the refund being initiated.
Refund.r1: Each creation made for Vairutya goes through stringent quality checks.
Refund.r2: Small variations in finish and detail are natural characteristics of the handmade process, and are not defects.
Refund.r3: Any purchase can be exchanged for a different creation. If what you'd like isn't available, we'll give you a studio credit valid for 6 months.
Refund.r4: To start an exchange or return, email care@vairutya.com with your order number handy. You'll find your order number under My orders in your account.
Refund.r5: Vairutya reserves the right not to accept returns if the product has been used or damaged by the customer.
Refund.contact: For any questions about a product or your order, contact our team at care@vairutya.com.

Shipping.intro: We currently ship within India only. International shipping will be announced here when available.
Shipping.processing: Orders are prepared and dispatched within [2–3] working days of payment. Because each piece is handcrafted, processing may occasionally take a little longer; we will email you if so.
Shipping.delivery: Delivery within India usually takes [5–7] working days after dispatch, via [COURIER NAME].
Shipping.charges: The shipping charge, and any free-shipping threshold, is shown in your cart and at checkout before you pay.
Shipping.tracking: When your order ships, we email you the carrier and tracking number. You can also find them under My orders in your account.
Shipping.issues: Please enter a complete address and a phone number the courier can reach. If a parcel is delayed, lost or arrives damaged, contact us at care@vairutya.com with your order number.
